lines.description: Research and engineering of vision-language architectures (VLMs/LLMs) applied to structured information extraction, complex layout reasoning, and neural OCR.
Investigation into the generalization capacity of spatial features, frequency-domain spectral cues (FFT), and self-supervised foundation backbones (DINOv3) under real-world corruptions.
Exploration of deep autoencoder ensembles, Self-Taught Learning, and Few-Shot Learning frameworks to train high-performing models in low-annotation regimes.
Techniques for cross-domain transfer learning, domain shift mitigation, and multimodal feature fusion across distributed environments.

projects.title: Representation Fusion for Domain Adaptation of Deep Models in Intelligent Parking Space Monitoring
projects.description: Applied research on representation fusion and domain adaptation for smart parking monitoring systems. Implementing and benchmarking Autoencoders (VAE, Denoising, and deep variants), CNNs, and federated models, establishing end-to-end data augmentation pipelines to mitigate domain discrepancies. Work spans empirical experimentation, metric evaluation, result visualization, and pipeline containerization using Podman for reproducibility.

projects.title: Domain Adaptation in Deep Classification Models Applied to Parking Space Detection
projects.description: Development of domain adaptation and few-shot learning methods for deep computer vision models applied to parking spot detection. Modeled CNNs, Autoencoders, and classical classifiers while exploring preprocessing and data augmentation techniques to boost stability and accuracy under low-data regimes, achieving results comparable to literature benchmarks.

publications.title: Benchmarking Spatial, Spectral, and Self-Supervised Cues for Face Forgery Detection under Realistic Degradation
publications.venue: 39th Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI 2026)
publications.abstract: A comprehensive benchmark assessing the generalization ability and forensic robustness of spatial convolutions, spectral cues (FFT), and self-supervised representations (DINOv3) under realistic degradations.

publications.title: An Ensemble-Based Self-Taught Learning Approach for Parking Space Classification Under Limited Data
publications.venue: IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
publications.abstract: An ensemble self-taught learning framework leveraging unsupervised autoencoder representations for robust parking space occupancy classification in data-constrained environments.
